title: The distant ground arrives ready-made
items: The ground that stretches to the horizon is now laid and cut when the site is published, so a phone no longer builds it each time the town opens. That removes about half a second of work from opening the town on the phone profile.
It adds 0.7 MB to the first download and still fits the 29 MB budget. On a data-saving or slow connection the browser builds the ground itself instead.
